correctness.rationale: Conjugate E to diag(1,0_d), parametrize F=uv^T with v^Tu=1 modulo (q-1) scalar frames. Put u=(a,x),v=(b,y), ab+yx=1, c=ab. The commutator has off-diagonal blocks ay and -bx, giving C^3=c(c-1)C. Split c=0,1,other and yx=1-c; rank and C² distinguish zero, J2, J3 while the invariant two-space gives cyclic companion(t²-delta). Counts: B=(q^d-1)q^(d-1), T=q^d(q^(d+1)-1)/(q-1), zero 1+B/(q-1), J2 2B+2(q^d-1), J3 (q^d-1)(q^(d-1)-1), companion(delta) m_q(delta)B. The char2 Artin-Schreier fiber is trace-zero with size2. Independent direct enumeration of every F in tested q,n=(2,2),(2,3),(3,2),(3,3),(5,2) reproduces the similarity-class histogram. Exhaustion is provided by the symbolic c partition for every q,n, not by these finite cases.
